data.title: Portable skill-local packaging for Codex/npx installs
data.claim: Package the knowledge-gate CLI, schema, and hooks inside the owning skill directory (not a plugin root); have setup install lifecycle hooks into host-specific config for portable Codex/npx installs.
data.body:
## Background
Codex and other `npx skills` installers copy or symlink only the individual skill directory — not any surrounding plugin root — and do not auto-register lifecycle hooks the way the Claude Code plugin loader does. The prior structure kept the CLI, schema, and hooks under the Claude Code plugin root and located them via `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT`, which does not exist in a Codex/npx-installed session.

## Details
Runtime execution assets (CLI script, schema/migrations, templates) live inside the skill directory that uses them (e.g. the `knowledge-gate` skill), so the same relative path resolves under both copy and symlink installs. The `setup` skill is responsible for installing lifecycle hook registration (`.codex/hooks.json` or `.claude/settings.json`) into the host repository, since portable skill installers do not register hooks themselves. Hooks resolve the CLI path explicitly, preferring a project-local skill install and falling back to `CODEX_HOME` for global installs.

## Rejected Alternatives
- Keep the Claude Code plugin-root structure: simpler for Claude Code but has no plugin-root env var or bundled path available in a Codex session installed via `npx skills`.
- Require a separate CLI install per agent: decouples the CLI version from the skill version and lowers reproducibility of `setup`.

## Open Questions
None identified from current evidence.

## Stop Conditions
Re-evaluate if Codex's `npx skills` installer starts supporting bundle-root references or automatic hook registration, or if a third agent platform introduces a different installation contract.
data.considerations: Applies specifically to portable/npx-based skill installs; Claude Code plugin installs via the marketplace structure are unaffected. Re-check if Codex's installer model changes.
